meta.name_en: PHYSICALLY AND MENTALLY DISABLED CITIZENS LIVING AND DEMAND ASSESSMENT SURVEY
meta.data_description_zh:
調查對象為台閩地區身心障礙者，主要調查身心障礙者其基本資料、居住及起居生活
狀況、個人及家庭經濟狀況、休閒活動、社會參與狀況、外出交通狀況、相關無障礙
設施使用情形、教育學習狀況、對福利服務及醫療照顧需求、工作現況及職業重建服
務需求等資料，以作為政府及民間團體推動身心障礙者各項福利服務措施之參考，使
身心障礙者獲得更妥適的生活照顧。此外，亦可作為各級政府機關(單位)釐訂身心障
礙者相關福利服務政策之重要參考。
本次調查採採「分層二階段系統隨機抽樣法」，派員實地訪問方式。
meta.notes_zh:
1. 本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分
證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期
等欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出
經審核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。
2. 因年度不同，資料欄位不盡相同。
3. 調查表分主卷(針對個案樣本)與副卷(針對主要家庭照顧者)，為避免影響主卷(A
表)之回表與調查品質，主要家庭照顧者副卷(B 表)係採由主要照顧者自願填答
方式辦理，回收樣本分配未必與母體一致，應用時請審慎。 無
meta.name_zh_from_listing: 資料庫使用手冊Welfare6_身心障礙者生活需求調查檔(89年)
meta.data_description_en:
The survey subjects were persons with disabilities in the Taiwan-Fukien Area. The survey mainly covered their basic information, living and daily-life conditions, personal and family economic status, leisure activities, social-participation status, transportation for going out, use of related accessibility facilities, education and learning status, needs for welfare services and medical care, and current employment status and vocational-rehabilitation service needs, to serve as a reference for the government and private organizations in promoting welfare service measures for persons with disabilities and to enable them to receive more appropriate life care. It also serves as an important reference for government agencies at all levels in formulating welfare-service policies related to persons with disabilities.
This survey used a "stratified two-stage systematic random sampling method," with in-person field interviews conducted by assigned staff.
meta.notes_en:
1. This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insured unit code, tax ID number, date of birth, visit date, and admission date have been masked. The data may only be used within the independent workspace established by the Ministry, and only approved aggregate statistical results may be taken out, ensuring that the data and its disclosure method can no longer identify specific individuals.
2. Data fields vary somewhat by survey year.
3. The questionnaire is divided into a main form (Form A, for the case sample) and a supplementary form (Form B, for primary family caregivers). To avoid affecting the response rate and quality of the main form (Form A), the primary-family-caregiver supplementary form (Form B) was completed on a voluntary basis by the primary caregiver, and the distribution of the collected sample may not match that of the population; please use this data with caution. None

meta.name_en: PHYSICALLY AND MENTALLY DISABLED CITIZENS LIVING AND DEMAND ASSESSMENT SURVEY
meta.data_description_zh:
本調查原名「臺灣地區殘障者生活狀況調查」，於民國 83 年由內政部首次辦理，84
年第 2 次辦理，調查區域範圍擴及金馬地區，89 年第 3 次辦理時調查名稱改為「身
心障礙者生活需求調查」，由內政部、衛生署及勞工委員會共同辦理，92年、95年、
100年各辦理 1次，本次為第7次調查。
本調查係依據身心障礙者權益保障法第 11條規定辦理，調查目的在於了解我國領有
身心障礙手冊或證明者之生活狀況與需求，以提供政府規劃各項身心障礙福利服務
之參考依據，調查內容包含身心障礙者之基本資料、居住及起居生活狀況、休閒活動
及交通狀況、個人及家庭經濟狀況、健康及醫療照顧、教育服務需求、社會參與及自
我決定、工作現況及職業服務需求等議題之調查。調查方法採實地訪查方式辦理，自
105年12月5 日至106年4月30日執行調查工作。
本次調查共完成訪問 14,120 位身心障礙者，其中 8,053 位為無法完全獨立自我照顧
生活起居且有家庭照顧者的身心障礙者。當中有 3,082人接受主要家庭照顧者問卷訪
問。
meta.notes_zh:
1. 本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分
證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日
期等欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並
攜出經審核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當
事人。
2. 因年度不同，資料欄位不盡相同。
3. 調查表分主卷(針對個案樣本)與副卷(針對主要家庭照顧者)，為避免影響主卷(A
表)之回表與調查品質，主要家庭照顧者副卷(B 表)係採由主要照顧者自願填答
方式辦理，回收樣本分配未必與母體一致，應用時請審慎。 檔案資料比對的鍵值：樣本編號(ID_SAMPLE)。
meta.name_zh_from_listing: 資料庫使用手冊Welfare6_身心障礙者生活需求調查檔(105年)
meta.data_description_en:
This survey was originally named the "Taiwan Area Survey on the Living Conditions of the Handicapped," first conducted by the Ministry of the Interior in 1994 (ROC year 83), with a 2nd round in 1995 (ROC year 84), when the survey area was expanded to include the Kinmen-Matsu Area. In the 3rd round in 2000 (ROC year 89), the survey name was changed to the "Survey on the Living Needs of Persons with Disabilities," jointly conducted by the Ministry of the Interior, the Department of Health, and the Council of Labor Affairs; it was conducted once each in 2003, 2006, and 2011 (ROC years 92, 95, and 100), and this round is the 7th survey.
This survey was conducted pursuant to Article 11 of the Rights Protection Act for Persons with Disabilities. Its purpose was to understand the living conditions and needs of persons holding a disability manual or certificate in Taiwan, in order to provide the government with a reference for planning various welfare services for persons with disabilities. The survey content covered topics such as basic information, living and daily-life conditions, leisure activities and transportation, personal and family economic status, health and medical care, educational service needs, social participation and self-determination, and current employment status and vocational service needs for persons with disabilities. The survey method used in-person field visits, conducted from December 5, 2016 (ROC year 105) to April 30, 2017 (ROC year 106).
This survey completed interviews with a total of 14,120 persons with disabilities, of whom 8,053 were persons with disabilities who were unable to fully care for themselves independently in daily life and had a family caregiver. Of these, 3,082 people's primary family caregivers were interviewed via questionnaire.
meta.notes_en:
1. This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insured unit code, tax ID number, date of birth, visit date, and admission date have been masked. The data may only be used within the independent workspace established by the Ministry, and only approved aggregate statistical results may be taken out, ensuring that the data and its disclosure method can no longer identify specific individuals.
2. Data fields vary somewhat by survey year.
3. The questionnaire is divided into a main form (Form A, for the case sample) and a supplementary form (Form B, for primary family caregivers). To avoid affecting the response rate and quality of the main form (Form A), the primary-family-caregiver supplementary form (Form B) was completed on a voluntary basis by the primary caregiver, and the distribution of the collected sample may not match that of the population; please use this data with caution. The key for matching file data: sample number (ID_SAMPLE).
